title: What Finance Teams Build with AI: 5 Custom Tools That Replace $30K/Year in SaaS
summary: Finance teams build custom expense workflows, budget dashboards, invoice managers, and vendor trackers with AI. Here are the 5 tools replacing $30K/year in SaaS.
body_markdown: Blink apps run on standard cloud infrastructure with HTTPS, Postgres with encrypted data at rest, and built-in authentication. For most SMB and mid-market finance teams, this security posture is comparable to or better than the SaaS tools they currently use. For regulated industries (banking, public companies with SOX requirements), evaluate the specific compliance requirements before replacing a certified tool.
